ValueSet-reason-for-no-method-at-exit-va.description: JSON Schema for Reason for no method at exit values ValueSet codes. Values are represented as Coding objects with 'system' and 'code' properties.
ValueSet-reason-for-no-method-at-exit-va.narrative: This schema validates Coding-shaped objects for the Reason for no method at exit values ValueSet. Each value must be an object with 'system' (CodeSystem URI) and 'code' (fragment after '#') properties. Display values are available at http://fhir.org/guides/who/fp-cds/ValueSet-reason-for-no-method-at-exit-values.displays.json. The canonical IRI for a code can be reconstructed as system + '#' + code. For a complete listing of all ValueSets, see artifacts.html#terminology-value-sets.
